Plain text sample

The grammar has almost nothing to say about plain text, which is the point:
it exists so an unrecognised file still gets a language, indentation, and
soft wrap rather than nothing at all.

The three things it does scope are bullet points, one per marker:

• a strong bullet
• another strong bullet

· a light bullet
· another light bullet

* a star bullet
* another star bullet

  Indented text is its own paragraph. Leading whitespace is scoped
  separately from the paragraph body, which is what lets a wrapped line
  keep its indent.

Everything else — URLs like https://example.com, numbers like 1234, and
punctuation like {}[]()<> — is left unscoped on purpose.
